# Code of conduct

## The short version

Be decent. Assume the other person is trying to help. Disagree about the work, not the person.

## Not acceptable

Harassment of any kind, personal attacks, sustained disruption, publishing someone's private information, or unwelcome attention.

## Reporting

Contact an organisation owner directly on GitHub. Reports are handled by a maintainer not involved in the incident, and the reporter's identity is not shared with the person reported.

Consequences range from a private word to a permanent ban, depending on severity and pattern. We will tell you what we decided and why.

## Scope

Applies in every space this organisation runs — repositories, issues, pull requests, discussions — and when representing the project elsewhere.
